name: Open the apology letter
description: Verifies the main emotional interaction opens the first letter.
expected: The envelope opens, the apology letter becomes visible, and its handwritten text begins appearing continuously like it is being written on the paper.

name: Play a voice note on mobile
description: Verifies a voice note card can be played from a phone-sized layout.
steps: Scroll to the voice note section
expected: The play control changes to pause and playback starts without leaving the page.

name: Open a memory card
description: Verifies a memory opens into a focused modal and can be closed.
expected: A memory modal opens and closes back to the gallery.

name: Use the ambient music control
description: Verifies the persistent music control responds to a user tap.
expected: The control toggles its label and the page remains usable.
